commit_message:
[GlobalOpt] Fix crash in RaiseSpecialOps on buffer-semantics named ops

NamedImplicitCastOpConversion indexed getResultTypes()[0], which asserts
(TypeRange.h:156) on a buffer-semantics linalg op since it has no results.
A linalg.matmul with memref operands therefore crashed iree-compile with a
hard abort instead of a clean diagnostic.

Guard on hasPureTensorSemantics() before reasoning about results / rewriting
the body, matching the other patterns in this file (lines 48, 231). The op is
left untouched and compilation proceeds normally.

Fixes #24624

Signed-off-by: Alex-Wengg <hanweng9@gmail.com>
name: setup / setup

(TypeRange.h:156) on a buffer-semantics linalg op since it has no results.
A linalg.matmul with memref operands therefore crashed iree-compile with a
hard abort instead of a clean diagnostic.

Guard on hasPureTensorSemantics() before reasoning about results / rewriting
the body, matching the other patterns in this file (lines 48, 231). The op is
left untouched and compilation proceeds normally.

Fixes #24624
